name: card-globe
blurb: 3D globe visualization with customizable colors and lighting.
description: Canvas-based 3D Earth globe with dynamic lighting, markers, and glow. Highly configurable: base color, marker color, glow color, lighting diffuse, map samples, rotation angle. Supports dark mode.
use_when: Global reach showcases, world maps, or location-based feature cards.
avoid_when: Devices without WebGL support or for users sensitive to 3D graphics.
a11y: Canvas element — decorative only. No text content. Consider adding aria-label or descriptive text nearby.
